Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/test_libFLAC/decoders.c","function":"stream_decoder_read_callback_","line":123,"var":"buffer","code":"*bytes = fread(buffer, 1, requested_bytes, dcd->file);","note":"A FLAC file supplied by the PoC is read into the decoder's input buffer."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"FLAC__stream_decoder_process_until_end_of_metadata","line":1041,"var":"decoder->private_->input","code":"The decoder parses metadata and then frame headers from the stream using the bitreader.","note":"The attacker-controlled file is handed off to the bitreader-backed decoder state machine."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_residual_partitioned_rice_","line":2764,"var":"rice_parameter","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32(decoder->private_->input, &rice_parameter, plen)) return false;","note":"Residual decoding begins by consuming Rice partition parameters from the input stream."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_residual_partitioned_rice_","line":2773,"var":"residual + sample","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block(decoder->private_->input, residual + sample, u, rice_parameter)) return false;","note":"The decoder requests a block of Rice-coded residuals, which drives the vulnerable bitreader deeper into the stream."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":744,"var":"cwords/words","code":"cwords = br->consumed_words; words = br->words;","note":"The bitreader snapshots its consumed position and available buffered words before iterating through residual values."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":780,"var":"b","code":"b = br->buffer[cwords] << br->consumed_bits;","note":"The current buffered word is dereferenced and shifted to process the next residual symbol."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":816,"var":"br->consumed_words / br->consumed_bits","code":"br->consumed_bits = FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD - ucbits; br->consumed_words = cwords;","note":"The loop can advance the cursor to the end of available buffered data while still expecting more residuals."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":384,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"const brword word = br->buffer[br->consumed_words];","note":"When the residual parser asks for the next bits after exhaustion, the bitreader indexes the buffer using the advanced consumed position; the vulnerability is the out-of-bounds read from this exhausted buffer state."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# construct a candidate FLAC file from an existing small file if present, otherwise empty placeholder
src = Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac/test.flac')
if src.exists():
    Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(src.read_bytes())
else:
    Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b'fLaC' + bytes(128))
